Package com.csse3200.game.areas.attic

Enum Class AtticProp

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<AtticProp>
com.csse3200.game.areas.attic.AtticProp
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<AtticProp>, Constable
public enum AtticProp extends Enum<AtticProp>
Furniture and ornaments that can be placed in an attic room, keyed by the names used in rooms.json ("prop" on a room prop, "sprite" on an exit).

Each entry is a pixel rectangle on one of the AtticSprites sheets plus a collision footprint. Sprites are drawn at their native size (16px = one terrain tile), so a 48x48 bookshelf covers 3x3 tiles. The footprint is a box centred along the bottom of the sprite: furniture is drawn from a three-quarter view, so only its base should block the player.
